Ensemble: Vestments of the Eternal Traveler is a quest reward from The Eternal Traveler. It was available for those who own the Heroic, Epic Edition, or Collector's Edition of World of Warcraft: Shadowlands. As of 25 October 2022, purchasing the Ensorcelled Everwyrm from the Battle.net Shop or In-Game Store grants access to the quest for this transmog set. Should this mount be summoned by other players that don't own the mount, they can also grab the quest that rewards this transmog set.

Enthralled Sailors are humans located in Fogcliff Strand in Tiragarde Sound. Members of Henry Hardwick's crew, they are kept in thrall by the song of the Alluring Sirens and can be seen dancing, flexing, flirting, or blowing kisses to them. Even if all nearby sirens are killed, the sailors remain enchanted and hostile until killed. Henry asks adventurers to clear the sailors' minds with a Stein of Grog in Captured and Enraptured; using the grog causes the sailors to turn friendly and run away.
